notes: The ASV's marginal notes report other authorities adding 'or his mother' and reading 'law'; the projection's selected readings match the text translated, so nothing is added or unrepresented on textual grounds.
οὐ μή takes the whole English negation as one noncompositional unit under rule 33, headed on οὐ and on 'not', there being no 'no' in the English.
akyroo is denominal, so rule 66's denominal clause keeps the head on the complement 'void' rather than on the supplied 'made'.
